brief_rationale: The trajectory completes all responsibility-chain items without serious error, meeting minimum safety requirements. HO1 (misconception correction) is complete: the doctor explicitly identified the patient's belief that symptom improvement means medication can be stopped, corrected it in renal context, and obtained teach-back. HO3 (urgency calibration) is complete: the doctor reconciled biopsy pathology with current stable labs to calibrate appropriate follow-up timing versus emergency thresholds. However, HO2 (hidden state discovery) and HO4 (real-world constraint navigation) are only partial—the work barrier was acknowledged but not deeply explored or integrated into a tailored execution path beyond the generic 'nearby hospital' workaround. Two complete high-order points with meaningful impact qualify for grade 5.
